title: The Boys Are Back. Dhamaal 4 Drops This Thursday — and the Trade Expects a Monster Opening.
excerpt: Ajay Devgn, Arshad Warsi, and the whole gang return for a treasure hunt seven years in the making. Opening-day prediction: ₹14-19 crore.
body:
They're back. All of them. And this time, there's gold involved.

<youtube></youtube>

**Dhamaal 4** lands in cinemas this Thursday, July 10 — bringing back the franchise that turned **Ajay Devgn**, **Arshad Warsi**, **Riteish Deshmukh**, **Jaaved Jaaferi**, and **Sanjay Mishra** into India's most beloved on-screen gang of lovable idiots. Seven years after **Total Dhamaal** raked in ₹154 crore and proved the franchise was indestructible, director **Indra Kumar** is betting on the same formula that has worked since 2007: throw these men into an impossible situation, add a treasure, and let chaos reign.

The plot this time? A massive treasure hunt that sends the gang spiralling through a mountain of gold — and a mountain of trouble. Hilarious misadventures, unexpected twists, and an endless parade of hurdles stand between them and the loot. Who among them comes out the smartest (or luckiest) is anyone's guess, but let's be honest — nobody watches a Dhamaal film for the plot. You watch it for Arshad Warsi's expressions, Jaaved Jaaferi's physical comedy, Riteish doing something unhinged, and Ajay Devgn standing in the middle of it all wondering how he got here again.

## The New Faces

The core gang is intact, but this time they've brought company. **Esha Gupta**, **Sanjeeda Shaikh**, and **Anjali Anand** join the ensemble, adding a dynamic the franchise hasn't explored before. **Ravi Kishan** and **Upendra Limaye** round out the cast, while **Vijay Raaz** narrates — because of course he does. If you've seen the trailer, you already know: this one is going for maximum chaos.


> The trailer launch was held at Imagicaa, transforming the theme park into an immersive extension of the film's world — a first-of-its-kind move that signals just how big the makers are thinking.

## Box Office Expectations

Trade analysts are predicting a **₹14 to ₹19 crore opening day**, which would make it one of the stronger comedy openings of 2026. Advance bookings are already live, and the franchise's recall value — amplified by years of television reruns and meme culture — gives it a built-in audience that most films would kill for.

The timing is strategic, too. **Dhamaal 4** was originally slated for July 17, but the makers preponed it by a week to grab the July 10 slot after **Alpha** moved up to July 3. The shift gives it a clean week before Christopher Nolan's **The Odyssey** arrives on July 17 — a smart play that avoids a head-on collision with what will be the biggest Hollywood release of the summer.

It also means Dhamaal 4 goes up against Alpha's weakening second week. Alia Bhatt's spy thriller is tracking toward ₹47 crore in its first week — solid but not dominant — and a family entertainer arriving right behind it could hoover up the screens that Alpha vacates.

## The Franchise That Refuses to Die

There's something admirable about the Dhamaal series. The original 2007 film wasn't a massive hit on release — it found its audience on television, where it became one of the most-replayed comedies in Indian broadcast history. **Double Dhamaal** in 2011 surprised the trade with a strong opening. **Total Dhamaal** in 2019 opened at ₹16.50 crore and ran to ₹154 crore — proving that the franchise had quietly become one of Bollywood's most bankable properties. Each installment has been bigger than the last, and the pattern suggests Dhamaal 4 has a real shot at being the biggest yet.

## Where to Watch for the Diaspora

**Dhamaal 4** is releasing worldwide, with international distribution handled by **AA Films**. For NRIs in the US, UK, and Canada looking for a guaranteed good time at the cinema this weekend, this is your movie. No complicated lore. No prerequisites. Just two and a half hours of people chasing treasure and falling on their faces.

Book your tickets now — advance bookings are live on BookMyShow and other platforms.

**Dhamaal 4 hits cinemas worldwide on July 10, 2026.**
